notes.title: Gas Station Simulator with a release date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Our friends over at DRAGO entertainment have been working on a new simulation game that is being released very soon! As we are all part of one big developer family, we would like to spread this exciting news. Their Gas Station Simulator is being released on 15/09/2021 on Steam. 

Visit their Steam page below for more info!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/
